task.title: Support all SSE line endings across chunks
task.objective: Recognize LF, CRLF, and lone CR without delaying valid event dispatch
acceptance_criteria: LF, CRLF, and lone CR terminate SSE lines
A CRLF pair split across transport chunks is consumed as one terminator
A trailing blank CR dispatches immediately and a following LF cannot redispatch

attempts.summary: Added lone-CR and split-CRLF parser regressions
attempts.diagnostic: A valid CR-delimited stream returned no events

attempts.summary: Recognized either line-ending byte and retained one-bit state to swallow only a cross-chunk CRLF continuation

outcome.summary: The bounded SSE parser accepts every specified line ending and preserves immediate dispatch across transport boundaries

verification.command: GitHub Rust quality gate for PR 1078

lessons: Chunk boundaries require explicit minimal parser state when one delimiter can extend another
Dispatch complete protocol records immediately instead of waiting for transport bytes that may never arrive
